SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) 
FROM Patient p 
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID 
WHERE l.IGA > 80 AND l.IGA < 500 AND strftime('%Y', p.`First Date`) >= '1990'
